formula: p=n/N; a=1/(PPE*K); x=a*p/sum(a*p); J_ik=a_k*(delta_ik-x_i)/sum(a*p); C_count=J*(diag(p)-p*pT)/N*JT; H_ik=-x_k*(delta_ik-x_i)/PPE_k; C_PPE=H*diag(SD^2)*HT; C_total=C_count+C_PPE; SE=sqrt(diag(C_total))
limitations: Independent saved-input numerical equation/covariance qualification, not source-row acquisition, calibration, full vegetation composition, cross-country comparable panel, reconstructed basin history, source rights or ecological accuracy. The 2/3/6-target panels have distinct denominators; assumed diagonal PPE uncertainty is shared within a case, not an independently measured covariance. Cross-window/case joint PPE dependence is not propagated. Conditional plug-in zero variance at count zero is not an absence interval. Physical factors are saved inputs to this checker; their independent geometry qualification is a distinct job.
